status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Banks (knee) was a limited participant in practice Thursday.
status.longComment: The starting left guard was limited Wednesday as well after missing Green Bay's Week 1 loss to Minnesota. Banks was also unable to fully practice ahead of that contest. Donovan Jennings is Green Bay's first backup guard in case Banks can't go this Sunday against the Jets.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Bako-Bewele (knee) was a limited participant in practice Thursday.
status.longComment: The starting right tackle was also limited Wednesday. He played through the knee injury in Week 1 but appears to still be dealing with the issue. Bako-Bewele was also limited in practice last week.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Hargrave (knee/concussion) did not participate in practice Thursday.
status.longComment: The defensive tackle was limited Wednesday. Hargrave played on 29 defensive snaps and one special-teams snap last week against Minnesota, making one tackle. If he can't go Sunday, Jonathan Ford is the next man up at nose tackle.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Wyatt (ankle) was a limited participant at the Packers' practice Wednesday.
status.longComment: Wyatt was able to play 53 percent of the team's defensive snaps while recording three solo tackles in Green Bay's 39-22 loss to the Vikings in Week 1 after he was limited at practice the entire week. The defensive lineman appears to be on the same track ahead of Week 2, and he'll have two more chances to log a full practice prior to Sunday's matchup with the Jets.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Van Ness (concussion) was limited at the Packers' practice Wednesday.
status.longComment: Van Ness recorded four solo tackles, including 1.0 sacks, in the team's 39-22 loss to the Vikings in Week 1, but he appears to have suffered a concussion at some point in the contest. The 25-year-old's ability to practice in any capacity is a positive sign, but he will have to clear concussion protocol in order to play Sunday on the road versus the Jets.
